headline: Tactical Space C2 and deterministic physics. Open to verify, built to field.
intro: Edgesource builds SpaceEdge for DoD, intelligence and prime programs on top of SpaceAware, the live browser workspace anyone can verify without signing in. Every orbit, sensor volume, RF link budget and conjunction study runs on deterministic WebAssembly physics modules, canonical Space Data Standards (SDS) FlatBuffers and the SDN-AP propagator—deployable from an open browser to an air-gapped tactical node.
flagshipLede: While vendors pitch generative-AI slideware and legacy desktop tools charge tens of thousands per seat, Edgesource delivers an operational 4D astrodynamics, sensor/EW and conjunction engine that runs identically in an open browser, on a tactical edge server, or inside an air-gapped SCIF.

pillars.title: Eliminate the legacy desktop per-seat tax
pillars.summary: Replace $15k–$50k/seat desktop astrodynamics installs with OrbPro, a zero-install 4D engine running directly in an accredited Chromium browser with zero external-origin bytes.
points: Render the entire catalog, phased-array/EO/IR/RF sensor volumes ($SEN) and solar-system bodies at high frame rates
Interactive RIC-frame Rendezvous & Proximity Operations (RPO) and burn-sequence targeting in the browser
Command-wide or program-wide site deployment without per-operator seat lock-in

pillars.title: Air-gapped SDN node and resilient mesh sync
pillars.summary: Deploy a single self-contained binary and signed WebAssembly module bundle onto SIPR, JWICS, CDAO environments, shipboard servers or disconnected DIL links.
points: Ingest customer-authorized Unified Data Library (UDL) feeds and local sensors on the customer's own node
Cache signed SDS FlatBuffer shards locally in FlatSQL with zero external network calls
Synchronize updates peer-to-peer via $PNM notifications across contested or intermittent links

pillars.title: Deterministic physics substrate for autonomous C2
pillars.summary: Generative AI cannot guess orbital mechanics, covariance realism or RF link budgets in a battle-management loop. SpaceEdge provides the deterministic tool layer AI agents call.
points: Isomorphic wasm32-wasip1-threads modules produce byte-identical answers in browser, WasmEdge and native hosts
60+ auditable modules covering orbit determination, conjunction Pc, maneuver targeting and sensor tasking
Human-on-the-loop 4D console shares the exact binary state vector and FlatSQL store as autonomous agents

pillars.title: Space Domain Awareness + EW / Spectrum in one workspace
pillars.summary: Unify orbital custody and maneuver indications & warning with electromagnetic spectrum operations, backed by Edgesource Corporation's cleared defense engineering footprint.
points: Physical RF link budgets ($RFB), antenna patterns, rain/cloud/gaseous loss and terrain diffraction
Co-channel interference, jamming geometry and TDOA/FDOA emitter geolocation workflows
METOC cloud and sea-state layers tied directly to optical and RF collection windows

acquisitionLede: Every core engine layer—OrbPro 4D visualization, SDN-AP propagation, FlatSQL local storage and 60+ signed WebAssembly physics modules—is built and verifiable today. Government funds go directly to sponsor-specific sensor onboarding, UDL workflows, accreditation and tactical fielding rather than from-scratch software R&D.

dataRule: Public records stay free and visible without a subscription or sign-in, each with its credit and terms. Plans pay for processing and program deployment, never for the public records themselves, and paying does not change any source's terms. Every source carries one rights class.

general.title: General-purpose rights
general.text: Free for any use, commercial included, with the credit each source asks. Share-alike sources require derived records to carry the same terms.

non-commercial.title: Non-commercial rights only
non-commercial.text: Free for non-commercial use only. Shown signed out and free; no plan sells them.

results.title: Results only
results.text: Used to compute results and cited by name. The records themselves are never republished.

talkingPoints.title: Lead with SpaceEdge and the $5M/yr program model
talkingPoints.text: SpaceAware's free open catalog is the instant proof that separates us from AI vaporware and legacy slideware. SpaceEdge—funded via SBIR Phase I/II/III, TACFI/STRATFI, prime OEM subcontracts and enterprise node licenses—is the core revenue engine for Edgesource.

talkingPoints.title: Displace legacy per-seat desktop taxes & power autonomous C2
talkingPoints.text: DoD and primes spend tens of millions on desktop astrodynamics seats that cannot run in a zero-install SCIF browser or serve as a deterministic tool bus for AI agents. OrbPro + SDN-AP + isomorphic WASM modules solve both.

talkingPoints.title: Keep public data free as our zero-friction evaluation funnel
talkingPoints.text: Any TPOC, evaluator or prime engineer can open spaceaware.io in three seconds without signing in. Paid plans and SpaceEdge contracts sell deterministic processing, UDL integration, air-gapped deployment and program execution—never public datasets.

talkingPoints.title: Use the right product name
talkingPoints.text: SpaceEdge is the government and prime program offering by Edgesource Corporation. SpaceAware is the live workspace. Space Data Network (SDN) carries signed data and WASM modules. SDN-AP is the propagator. OrbPro is the 4D visualization engine.
